points.description: Every step is mathematically valid and the final answer is 4225π/64 (equivalently (65/8)^2 π ≈ 66.02π/… i.e. πR² with R=65/8). Any invalid step or a wrong final answer earns 0.

rubric.notes: Full mark only if all reasoning is valid and the final area is 4225π/64. Any wrong step (e.g. wrong circumradius, wrong tangency condition, locus not a circle of radius R about O) or wrong final answer earns 0. No part marks.
rubric.answer_key: Circumradius of 13-14-15 triangle: area 84, R = abc/(4K) = 13·14·15/336 = 65/8. Reflecting through P is a homothety of ratio -1 centered at P, so circle P_A P_B P_C has radius R and center O' = 2P − O. Two circles of equal radius R meet in exactly one point only when externally tangent (if centers coincide they share every point), so |OO'| = 2R. |OO'| = 2|P − O|, so |P − O| = R. The locus is a circle of radius R centered at O. Area = πR² = π(65/8)² = 4225π/64.
